$:set -euo pipefail
endpoint=user/codespaces/shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96
state() { gh api "$endpoint" --jq .state; }
current=$(state)
if [ "$current" != Shutdown ]; then
  if [ "$current" != ShuttingDown ]; then
    gh api --method POST "$endpoint/stop" >/dev/null
  fi
  for attempt in {1..25}; do
    current=$(state)
    [ "$current" = Shutdown ] && break
    sleep 4
  done
  [ "$current" = Shutdown ] || { echo "Stop timed out: $current"; exit 1; }
fi
echo "Stopped: $current"
gh api --method POST "$endpoint/start" >/dev/null
for attempt in {1..30}; do
  current=$(state)
  if [ "$current" = Available ]; then echo "Restarted: $current"; exit 0; fi
  sleep 4
done
echo "Start timed out: $current"
exit 1
